checkpoints.summary: Build the printable D-shaped shell from an outer body and a cavity driven by named wall margin.
Add a solid base and a central drain with named drain edge margin.
Prove one spade-shaped through-wall cutter using a named cutter overshoot.
Generate the front wall pattern with repeat-union, then subtract one cutter group once.
Complete printable holder with generated front and side spade groups, named margins, drain, and one final boolean.
